name: Volumetric Fur Rendering with LDPRT
aliases: Lengyel et al. fur with PRT
definition: A method combining real-time fur rendering with LDPRT lighting to capture microgeometric self-shadowing in a volumetric fur model.
summary: Volumetric Fur Rendering with LDPRT renders realistic fur microgeometry with global lighting and self-shadowing at real-time speeds using a multi-layered shell model and precomputed light attenuation.
